jobs.location: Bratislava, Slovakia; Warsaw, Poland; Wien, Austria; Zagreb, Croatia
jobs.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

The Associate Operations Manager for Supply Activation & Acquisition plays a pivotal role at Wolt. As Central scales at an unprecedented pace, your mission is to keep courier supply ahead of demand - both in the moment and over the medium term. You will be responsible for leading and mentoring a team of 3, ensuring that intraday activation (weather-driven boosts, DxGy and ARC / radius adjustments) and courier acquisition (job boards, application attainment, reactivations and sign-ups) are tightly coordinated across all Central markets.

In this role, you will own two of Central’s most closely tracked supply KPIs - undersupplied hours and GOV loss - reported weekly to senior leadership, alongside a multi-million euro activation and acquisition budget. Your leadership extends beyond day-to-day activation calls; you will be the primary bridge to higher management on supply health, escalating risks early and proposing structural fixes such as mobilizer strategies and special events planning ahead of demand spikes (holidays, weather events, local events). Your ability to translate data into fast, defensible calls will be key to keeping Central’s ADT, UH% and GOV loss on plan.

What you’ll be doing

- Own Central’s intraday activation strategy - activation surges, special events management and day-to-day operations (radius / busyness adjustments, communication flows, etc.) - to keep courier supply matched to demand hour by hour.

- Lead and mentor a team of 3 and own a multi-million euro activation and acquisition budget across Central markets.

- Own Central’s courier acquisition function: job boards, application attainment, reactivation campaigns and sign-ups.

- Own and report on Central’s UH% and GOV loss KPIs weekly, surfacing risks and driving corrective action with senior leadership.

- Plan and execute mobilizer strategies and special events coverage (holidays, weather events, local events) ahead of demand spikes.

- Partner with Support, Product and Global Delivery Ops to build tools and processes that scale activation and acquisition across markets.

- Serve as the primary point of contact for top management on Central’s supply health.

Our humble expectations

- Proven track record managing complex, data-driven operations across multiple markets, ideally in courier / gig supply, logistics or marketplace operations.

- Comfortable owning hard KPIs (UH%, GOV loss) and being accountable for the numbers, not just reporting them.

- Experience leading and developing a small team (3 direct reports).

- Strong budget ownership experience - able to allocate and defend a multi-million euro spend across activation and acquisition levers.

- Excellent ability to distill complex operational trade-offs into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leadership.

- Comfortable working under time pressure during weather events, special events and demand spikes.

- Fluent English skills in both spoken and writing.

Additional information

What to expect from our hiring process:

- Talent Acquisition screen — an introductory conversation with our recruiter to learn more about your background and answer any initial questions about the role.

- Hiring Manager interview — a deeper conversation with the team manager about your experience, the team, and what this role involves day to day.

- Assignment — a practical task related to the role, giving you a chance to show how you approach real problems in this space.

- Final interview — a conversation with a senior stakeholder to round out the process.

If you are excited about working in a high-growth environment, taking ownership and being part of an extremely ambitious team, then click below to apply and get the conversation going!

We will be reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so if this sounds like an opportunity you want to pursue, apply today!

Please submit your up-to-date resume in English.

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Manager, EMEA Growth & Engagement
jobs.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

We are looking for a Strategy & Operations Manager to join our EMEA Growth & Engagement team, which owns the growth and engagement of Wolt+ and Deliveroo Plus across 40+ markets in Europe and the Middle East and is working to build the best local commerce membership programs in the markets we operate in.

You will join our Engagement pod, which focuses on understanding what turns a subscriber into a healthy, engaged and long-term member. You will be responsible for i) identifying and prioritising the largest opportunities to improve our member experience and subscription health, ii) understanding how customer needs and behaviours evolve across different stages of the Plus lifecycle, and iii) driving the highest-priority opportunities from strategy through experimentation and execution to tangible business results.

To get the job done, you’ll work closely with our wider subscription team and cross-functional teams across Product, Engineering, Data Science & Analytics, Marketing, Commercial and Finance, while taking full ownership of driving your initiatives to fruition and, most importantly, measurable results.

Our team is responsible for driving the growth and long-term health of our subscription programs. Your exact problem space may evolve as our priorities change, but in practice you will:

- Build a clear view of the largest opportunities to improve member engagement and subscription health across EMEA. Use customer behaviour, market performance and economics to size opportunities and prioritise the areas most likely to materially move our business results.

- Understand the member lifecycle end to end, identifying where customers struggle to onboard, build habit, discover value or remain engaged, and translate those insights into practical interventions that improve customer and business outcomes.

- Own initiatives from initial problem definition through to execution and results, working closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science & Analytics, Marketing, Commercial and Finance.

- Build and run an experimentation roadmap against the highest-priority opportunities. Translate business problems into clear hypotheses, design A/B tests or other appropriate experiments, analyse the results and make decisions on whether initiatives should be scaled, iterated or stopped.

- Track and own the key performance indicators relevant to your problem space and, where necessary, drive corrective actions. This may mean pulling shorter-term lifecycle levers or shaping longer-term Product and Engineering solutions to address underlying drivers.

- Collaborate closely with local and regional teams to ensure our strategies reflect customer needs and market context, and turn successful approaches into repeatable playbooks that can scale across Wolt+ and Deliveroo Plus.

- Keep a close eye on our customer experience and identify opportunities to make Plus easier to understand, use and get value from throughout the membership lifecycle.

The Engagement pod works across a broad range of customer problems. Examples could include improving the first 30–60 days of membership, onboarding and early order progression, benefit discovery and adoption, lifecycle and CRM journeys, programs that drive incremental order frequency and activity, and initiatives that improve longer-term member engagement and retention.

Our humble expectations

- 5+ years of relevant experience, preferably in i) strategy & operations, consumer growth or engagement at a leading consumer technology / platform company, ii) subscriptions, loyalty or membership businesses, or iii) management consulting with subsequent operating experience.

- Problem-solving and prioritisation skills: our team is in the business of solving hard problems and developing new solutions. There is rarely a ready-made playbook to follow, so you’ll need to be comfortable structuring ambiguous problems, getting into the details and identifying which opportunities are most likely to move the needle.

- Analytical and experimentation skills: you’ll work with data every day and need to be comfortable identifying and sizing opportunities, designing and interpreting A/B tests and making decisions based on the results. Strong spreadsheet skills are a must-have and SQL experience is useful.

- Customer and lifecycle judgement: you are able to understand how customer behaviour and needs evolve across the membership journey, identify the moments that matter most and translate those insights into practical ways to improve onboarding, engagement and retention.

- Business ownership and independence: you have experience owning measurable business results and can demonstrate how you have taken a problem from initial analysis through to execution and impact. You’ll be given significant responsibility and freedom, so you need to be comfortable operating without a predefined roadmap.

- People and project management skills: you’ll need to be able to inspire and persuade colleagues from a broad spectrum of backgrounds and seniority levels and get cross-functional teams working towards one goal in a coordinated and efficient way.

- AI fluency: AI is increasingly part of how we work at Wolt day to day. You should already be comfortable using AI tools in your work, or be excited to quickly become so, and continuously look for ways to use them to work faster and solve problems better.

- Business acumen and eye for superb user experience: you’ll need to be able to see the forest for the trees and have good intuition about what works best for customers while understanding the economics and trade-offs behind business decisions.

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. - Move the headline metrics: restaurant spend per MAU, subtotal per order, units per order, the share of customers ordering across more than one daypart, and how much of what people want to order they can actually find

- Comfortable operating across many markets at once, where local tastes, price points, brands and maturity all differ

About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the Role

Trust and Safety focuses on proactively managing risks on the Wolt platform. The team also makes sure that trust and safety incidents are managed quickly, effectively and empathetically. It is a key priority for us that everyone can feel safe while using Wolt - be it for ordering, delivering, or selling goods.

Managing Safety risks is key to protecting our platform users (couriers, customers, merchants), and doing so with transparency and fairness is key to building trust with them. We are looking for a Senior Associate / Manager to support our Global Manager of Personal and Road Safety to scale our strategy and initiatives globally. In this role, you will support the development and execution of safety initiatives that increase safety for all of Wolt's platform users, while building trust through transparent and effective safety practices.

You will operate across both strategy and execution—owning key operational programs, identifying risks, and driving continuous improvement in our safety controls.

What You’ll Be Doing

- Driving local Personal and Road Safety improvements across markets, ensuring initiatives are tailored to regional needs while aligned with global strategy

- Analyzing market-level safety trends and incident data, identifying key risk areas, and translating insights into actionable improvements

- Designing and implementing targeted safety initiatives to reduce incidents and improve outcomes for couriers and other platform users

- Building and maintaining strong relationships with external stakeholders, including NGOs, public sector bodies, and local authorities

- Collaborating cross-functionally with Product, Support, Legal, Policy, and Operations teams to implement safety improvements at scale

- Optimizing and evolving incident management tools and processes to ensure effectiveness and scalability

- Conducting deep dives into safety incidents and root causes, and driving continuous improvement in prevention and response mechanisms

- Supporting rollout of best practices and safety standards across regions

- Enabling local teams through training, guidance, and playbooks on personal and road safety topics

Qualifications

- 4–6 years of experience in Operations, Strategy & Planning, Trust & Safety, Risk, or similar fields, ideally within the Platform/Gig economy

- Experience or strong interest in Personal Safety, Road Safety, or Operational Risk management

- Knowledge/experience working with Jira and Looker tools

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights

- Proven program/project management experience

- Excellent communication and internal and external stakeholder management skills

- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment

- Experience building or scaling processes, policies, or operational programs

- Fluency in English and German (both written and spoken) is required . Additional language skills (French, Greek etc.) are a plus

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .
